component.subject: Call to Worship
component.source: Habakkuk 2:20 (World English Bible); "Yahweh" rendered "the Lord", opening "But" omitted.

original.p: Habakkuk 2:20 (WEB): But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

p.line: The Lord is in his holy temple.
Let all the earth be silent before him!
